title: Black students make up 3.9% of Theresa Primary School's enrollment for 2025-26
text:
Theresa Primary School had six Black students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, an increase of 100% compared to the prior year, data from the New York State Education Department show.
Out of a total of 154 students attending Theresa Primary School in the 2025-26 school year, Black students accounted for 3.9% of the student body, making them the third largest ethnic group in the school.
The school is part of the Indian River Central School District, which is headquartered in Theresa.
Within the district’s eight schools, Indian River Middle School reported the largest Black student enrollment at that time, counting 71 students overall.
A World Population Review analysis found that New York’s public school system was ranked second in the nation overall but was 31st in K-12 performance rankings.
